title: Blink-Pause-Relation (Competing Speaker Paradigm)
description: This dataset pools EOG recordings from two earlier studies (20 participants from Jaeger et al., 2020 and 21 from Holtze et al., 2021) that used a competing-speaker paradigm. Participants attended to either the left or the right of two simultaneously presented audio books. The dataset supports analysis of the relation between eye blinks and speech pauses.
methods_description: Participants listened to two competing audio books and were instructed to attend to either the left or the right one. Each session comprised five or six 10-minute blocks. In Jaeger et al. (2020) both audio books were always equally loud. In Holtze et al. (2021) blocks alternated between an omnidirectional condition (equal loudness) and a beamforming condition (attended book louder). The first block was always omnidirectional, and the condition order was counterbalanced across participants for the later four blocks.
